summary_en: 660,000 shares (1.05% of shares outstanding), ¥600M aggregate budget. Open-market purchase on TSE. Execution window: 21 Aug to 18 Sep 2026 (contract basis). Rationale: flexible capital management and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Concerning Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Riso Kagaku Corporation announced on 31 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 660,000 shares of its own common stock under the authority of the Companies Act Article 165(3), read in conjunction with Article 156. The acquisition is intended to support flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions and to return value to shareholders. The company will acquire shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via open-market purchase between 21 August and 18 September 2026 (on a contract basis), with a total budget of ¥600 million. The shares to be acquired represent 1.05% of issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury), calculated against the 62,702,384 shares outstanding as of 30 June 2026.
